svg.title: A controlled comparison
svg.desc: Two columns, "GP3 runs" and "GP4 runs". Four wide gray boxes span both columns, marked tag 1: the trial file (seed, defect rate, time limit, challenges and times), the team configuration (sensors and poses, conveyor speed, feed rate), the software (skills release, executor, model name, version, settings) and the machine (the same computer for every run). Under them, marked tag 2, each column has its own white box with a heavy outline: "PDDL planner (GP3)" and "LLM agent (GP4)". At the bottom, marked tag 3, eight white run boxes in time order: 1: GP3, 2: GP4, 3: GP3, 4: GP4, and so on to 8: GP4, above an arrow labeled time.

path.aria-label: Trial file: seed, defect rate, time limit, challenges and times
Team configuration: sensors and poses, conveyor speed, feed rate
Software: skills release, executor, model name, version, settings
Machine: the same computer for every run
